original.target_description: PBGD ApaLI D1/D2 allele-frequency association between affected schizophrenia/schizoaffective subjects and normal controls, p. 213 Table 1; chi-square with one degree of freedom.

n.sample_role: Analytic allele/chromosome counts in the 2 × 2 association contingency table: 106 affected alleles and 102 control alleles. The corresponding contributor count is 104 participants (53 affected, 51 controls), not 208 participants.
n.exclusions: Rare alleles, persistent partial digests, and otherwise unscorable alleles excluded (p. 214). Table 1 final counts used, not the recruitment total of 55 affected and 51 controls. ApaLI Table 2 final genotypes total 53 affected and 51 controls; two affected participants lack usable ApaLI genotype information; specific reasons for those two are not individually stated.

notes: Only assigned unfinished fields assessed; unassigned fields are placeholders. Analytic N arithmetic: affected alleles 41 + 65 = 106; control alleles 56 + 46 = 102; mutually exclusive disease groups and allele categories sum to 208 alleles. Separately, Table 2 mutually exclusive genotypes give affected participants 6 + 29 + 18 = 53 and controls 16 + 24 + 11 = 51, total 104 participants; this is contributor N, not the allele-count unit of Table 1. No division by df or effect-size conversion. Same-test P = 0.02 retained in test_statistic; p field unassigned. PDF p. 213 and p. 215 visually inspected. Source title matches supplied reference; printed article header gives 1992 whereas supplied reference gives 1993.
